1.text: “Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bwagereranywa n'umuntu ufite urugo, yazindutse kare gushaka abahinzi ngo bahingire uruzabibu rwe.

2.text: Asezerana n'abahinzi idenariyo ku munsi umwe, abohereza mu ruzabibu rwe.

3.text: Isaha eshatu arasohoka, asanga abandi bahagaze mu iguriro nta cyo bakora,

4.text: na bo arababwira ati ‘Namwe mujye mu ruzabibu rwanjye ndi bubahe ibikwiriye.’

5.text: Baragenda. Yongera gusohoka mu isaha esheshatu n'isaha cyenda, abigenza atyo.

6.text: Isaha zibaye cumi n'imwe arasohoka, asanga abandi bahagaze arababaza ati ‘Ni iki kibahagaritse hano umunsi wose nta cyo mukora?’

7.text: Baramusubiza bati ‘Kuko ari nta waduhaye umurimo.’ Arababwira ati ‘Namwe mujye mu ruzabibu rwanjye.’

8.text: “Bugorobye nyir'uruzabibu abwira igisonga cye ati ‘Hamagara abahinzi ubahe ibihembo byabo, utangirire ku ba nyuma ugeze ku ba mbere.’

9.text: Abatangiye mu isaha cumi n'imwe baje, umuntu wese ahabwa idenariyo imwe.

10.text: Ababanje baje bibwira ko bahembwa ibirutaho, ariko umuntu wese ahembwa idenariyo imwe.

12.text: ‘Aba ba nyuma bakoze isaha imwe, ubanganyije natwe abahingitse umunsi wose tuvunika, twicwa n'izuba!’

13.text: “Na we asubiza umwe muri bo ati ‘Mugenzi wanjye, sinkugiriye nabi. Ntuzi ko twasezeranye idenariyo imwe?

14.text: Ngiyo yijyane ugende. Ko nshatse guhemba uwa nyuma nkawe,

15.text: mbese hari icyambuza kugenza ibyanjye uko nshaka, ko undeba igitsure, kuko ngize ubuntu!’

16.text: “Uko ni ko ab'inyuma bazaba ab'imbere, kandi ab'imbere bazaba ab'inyuma.”

17.text: Yesu yenda kuzamuka ngo ajye i Yerusalemu, yihererana n'abo cumi na babiri, ababwirira mu nzira ati

18.text: “Dore turazamuka tujya i Yerusalemu, Umwana w'umuntu azagambanirwa mu batambyi bakuru n'abanditsi, bamucire urubanza rwo kumwica.

19.text: Bazamugambanira mu bapagani bamushinyagurire, bamukubite imikoba bamubambe, ku munsi wa gatatu azazurwa.”

20.text: Maze nyina wa bene Zebedayo azana n'abana be aho ari, aramupfukamira ngo agire icyo amusaba.

21.text: Na we aramubaza ati “Urashaka iki?”Aramusubiza ati “Tegeka ko aba bana banjye bombi bazicara mu bwami bwawe, umwe iburyo bwawe undi ibumoso.”

22.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ntimuzi icyo musaba. Mwabasha kunywera ku gikombe nzanyweraho?”Bati “Turabibasha.”

23.text: Arababwira ati “Ni ukuri igikombe cyanjye muzakinyweraho, ariko kwicara iburyo bwanjye n'ibumoso si jye ubigaba, keretse abo Data yabitunganyirije.”

24.text: Ba bandi cumi babyumvise barakarira abo bavandimwe bombi.

25.text: Yesu arabahamagara arababwira ati “Muzi yuko abami b'abanyamahanga babatwaza igitugu, n'abakomeye babo bahawe kubategeka.

26.text: Ariko muri mwe si ko biri, ahubwo ushaka kuba mukuru muri mwe ajye aba umugaragu wanyu,

27.text: kandi ushaka kuba uw'imbere muri mwe, ajye aba imbata yanyu,

28.text: nk'uko Umwana w'umuntu ataje gukorerwa, ahubwo yaje gukorera abandi no gutangira ubugingo bwe kuba incungu ya benshi.”

29.text: Bakiva i Yeriko, abantu benshi baramukurikira.

30.text: Impumyi ebyiri zari zicaye iruhande rw'inzira, zumvise yuko Yesu ahanyura, zirataka cyane ziti “Mwami mwene Dawidi, tubabarire.”

31.text: Abantu barazicyaha ngo zihore, ariko zirushaho gutaka ziti “Mwami mwene Dawidi, tubabarire.”

32.text: Yesu arahagarara arazihamagara, arazibaza ati “Murashaka ko mbagirira nte?”

34.text: Yesu azigirira imbabazi akora ku maso yazo, uwo mwanya zirahumuka, baramukurikira.
